:::{#rem-cross-entropy-expected-surprisal}
#### Cross-entropy is an expected surprisal

By definition, the [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) $\crossentropyf{p}{q}$ is the [average](#def-expectation) [surprisal under $q$](#def-surprisal-under) of the values drawn from $p$.
By @cor-cross-entropy-entropy, the average surprisal under $p$ itself is the [entropy](#def-entropy).

:::
